about_short_description.short_description: Instacrops is an AI-Agentic Farming platform that helps farmers optimize irrigation, predict risk, and improve yields reducing 30% of water

product.name: Crop Advisor
product.description: A virtual crop advisor that collects real-time data to provide management recommendations and forecasts for crop health and irrigation needs.

product.name: InstaSoil (Standard/Temp/Plus)
product.description: A soil moisture and temperature monitoring system that tracks soil parameters to help manage irrigation timing and frequency.

product.name: InstaWeather (Standard/Plus)
product.description: A meteorological station that measures essential agroclimatic parameters to monitor field temperature, humidity, wind, and solar radiation.

product.name: InstaFlow
product.description: A remote irrigation controller that monitors and manages water flow and fertigation across multiple irrigation sectors.

product.name: InstaWell (Standard/Plus)
product.description: A monitoring and control system for deep wells that tracks water levels, flow rates, and pump status in real time.

product.name: SkyCrops
product.description: A diagnostic tool using drones and satellite imagery to provide multispectral crop data and vegetation indices for crop monitoring.
